notes: *of whom* is divided between the fused מִפְּנֵי (*of*) and אֲשֶׁר (*whom*), with the resumptive suffix unrepresented under rule 22 — the same disposition rule 43 gives אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מוּם. Reading all four morphemes as one rule 22 fusion is unavailable here because the ASV writes two words rather than one pronominal adverb.
Three attributive phrases each write one *the*: the first article takes it and the agreement article is unrepresented under rule 47.
אֲשֶׁר → *whereby* is the one-word pronominal adverb, headed on the relative.
